project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler, monorepo (frontend + backend workspaces)
build_system: npm workspaces, Vite for frontend, tsc for type checking
test_framework: No test framework found in frontend - AST/type validation only
build_command: NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc -b --noEmit (node_modules not installed in sandbox)
test_command: N/A - no tests configured, use AST validation
verification_instructions: Since node_modules are not available in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox, verify changes through: 1) Syntax correctness of CSS (no broken rules), 2) TypeScript source code validity by visual inspection (correct types, proper imports), 3) Ensure no conflicting CSS properties remain
setup_instructions: npm install from root (not available in sandbox)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install possible, no tsc compilation. Must validate through AST reading and code inspection only.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, no new npm packages, preserve RTL support, keep prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks
key_patterns: CSS loaded via main.tsx imports in order: tokens -> base -> components -> ... -> visual-final-polish -> world-class -> global-icon. Later files override earlier ones. Design tokens in stitch-tokens.css and tokens.css. Component state managed via zustand stores (ui.store.ts). Layout components in src/components/layout/. Bottom nav defined in notifications.css, shown via media query in stitch-canonical.css at max-width: 900px.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - all CSS files loaded from main.tsx. frontend/src/components/layout/ - AppShell, BottomNav, Sidebar, Topbar. frontend/src/stores/ - zustand stores (auth, ui, i18n, dashboard).
